title: Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich Diverge in Israel’s Election
summary_full: Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich lead ultranationalist parties that previously joined forces, in deals brokered by Benjamin Netanyahu. They are not on the same slate this time.
